assumptions.choice: Renko bricks are constructed using bar close prices, with initial boundaries aligned to brick size multiples relative to the first bar's close price.
assumptions.reason: The specification states to build Renko from OHLC data with a 50-point brick size without specifying exact intra-bar mechanics or initial baseline reference price.

assumptions.choice: Position size is computed as 100% of available cash divided by current bar close price.
assumptions.reason: The specification specifies 100% of available capital as the position sizing rule.

assumptions.choice: Entry signals require the last two consecutive Renko bricks to be in the same direction before placing an order.
assumptions.reason: The specification includes the two-brick trend confirmation filter under Additional rules.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss (1 brick size) and take-profit (2 brick sizes) orders are submitted as Stop and Limit orders upon completion of the entry order.
assumptions.reason: Execution price of a market order is known once the entry order completes, enabling precise placement of SL/TP relative to actual fill price.
